objective: Deliver an exact machine-readable worker response contract in every production execute/analysis message and make actual probes derive their public response solely from that contract.
required_behavior: For worker TASK/execute and QUESTION/analysis only, inject an explicit response contract alongside the normal payload. It must state the exact WB_WORKER_RESPONSE marker, exact 12-field compact flat JSON shape/order, immutable identity values, stage/kind/revision/session values, allowed decisions, response_id canonical UUID requirement, and instruction to emit only that frame with no prose/tool/thinking.
The bridge parser and injected contract must be generated from one source of truth so schema/field order/allowed decisions cannot drift.

The actual OMP scripted provider must read and obey the delivered response contract; remove hardcoded marker/schema/identity construction assumptions. A missing/malformed contract must not produce a valid response.

Do not put secret environment values, raw experiment evidence beyond the already approved payload, or mutable host authority into the contract. Preserve exact delivery identity and all public-event/privacy/replay guards.
required_tests: Assert production injected execute and analysis messages contain complete, self-consistent contracts with exact identity and decision set; non-worker/non-control messages do not gain the contract.
Mutate marker, field order/schema, immutable identity, allowed decisions, response ID requirement, or prose-only instruction and prove provider does not accidentally pass via hardcoding.

Run actual OMP 18.2.10 worker and independent probes using contract-derived responses, all public-response independent tests, Node bridge, workflow, bridge, G3, tasks, terminal suites, privacy/residue/git diff checks.
constraints: Use apply_patch only. Do not edit production workflow/task/storage code, docs, workflow artifacts, graphify, dependencies, or unrelated files.
Do not claim arbitrary model compliance; prove that the production message makes the protocol fully specified and that actual OMP carries a response derived from it.
No commit/push/merge/stash/reset/clean. Run graphify update . after code/test changes and report generated drift separately.
report: proof probes derive responses from delivered contract
snapshot/scope audit and candidate_ready or needs_reroute
